gaps.title: Keycap size apart from the density

gaps.title: Row, tab and segmented ink at rest
gaps.note: Supabase menu, ⌘K and dashboard nav rows in foreground-light (oklch 0.39 / 0.80), the current nav row in full ink (0.10 / 0.95) at 600 on #f3f3f3 / #1e1e1e, inactive tabs a step lighter (0.52 / 0.68, from the docs)

gaps.title: Per-role letter spacing
gaps.note: Supabase keycap labels at -0.025em (-0.275px at 11px) on the ⌘K chip, body and controls untracked
gaps.standin: Supabase's keycaps by 0.3px); `titleStyle: tight` gives -0.6px at 24px and tracks every heading

gaps.title: Button inline padding apart from height
gaps.note: Supabase 10px on its 26px buttons and 12px on some default ones (Restart project), signed in and on the dashboard sign-in page
gaps.standin: `compact` pads 8px on buttons (Supabase -2px, -4px on Restart project) and 6px on tabs

gaps.title: Focused field edge in a neutral step while the ring carries the color
gaps.note: Supabase's edge steps darker (#b0b0b0 / #4d4f4d) under a 2px mint ring at 55%, 2px out
gaps.standin: `focusInputStyle: ring` also turns the edge to the selection color (Supabase ΔE 0.18 / 0.27

gaps.title: Two control text sizes
gaps.note: Supabase buttons, menu rows, tooltips and segmented items at 12px while fields, select triggers, line tabs, nav rows, toggles and field labels set 13px (the signed-in dashboard agrees: New project and Restart project at 12/500, the project-name field and its label at 13/450, product-menu rows at 13)
gaps.standin: one UI size per density: `density: compact` gives every control 12px, `uiTextSize: 13` every control 13px (Supabase keeps `uiTextSize: 13`, right on fields, labels, selects, tabs and toggles and 1px large on buttons, menu rows, tooltips and segmented items: 14 rows each way

gaps.title: Neutral links at body weight
gaps.note: Supabase's at the text's size and weight (13/450) in foreground-light, underlined

gaps.title: Radios edged in the brand, checked or not
gaps.note: Supabase's RadioGroup items draw a 1px `border-primary` edge (oklch 0.525 0.12 / 0.76 0.15) while checkboxes keep the gray control edge
gaps.standin: `checkEdge: fields`, the gray field line at rest (ΔE 0.378 / 0.411); checked radios take the selection mint (ΔE 0.129 / 0.109)

gaps.title: Toggle buttons with a look of their own, apart from Button
gaps.note: No plate at rest: Supabase's Toggle and ToggleGroup items have no fill, edge or shadow (foreground-light ink, 6px corners), stepping to the accent tone when on (#f3f3f3 / #1e1e1e under foreground ink), while its default button is a raised plate; shadcn's default Toggle is the same
gaps.standin: ToggleButton shares the secondary button's look: on Supabase (`buttonSecondary: raised`) an edge and a drop at rest

gaps.title: Segmented control with no track
gaps.note: Supabase's toggle group (26px items at 12/500, foreground-light ink at rest) has no fill or edge behind the items, the selected one on a sliding chip on the accent tone (see the flat segmented chip row)
gaps.standin: `segmentedTrack: outline` draws a 1px track edge (on Supabase 8px corners at 32px
